crew.overview: A listless Wade Wilson toils away in civilian life with his days as the morally flexible mercenary, Deadpool, behind him. But when his homeworld faces an existential threat, Wade must reluctantly suit-up again with an even more reluctant Wolverine.
crew.title: Deadpool & Wolverine

details.biography:
Zeb Wells (born April 28, 1977) is an American comic book writer, screenwriter, director, and voice actor. He is known for his controversial Amazing Spider-Man comic book run and New Mutants comic book from Marvel Comics, as well as being a writer, director, and voice actor on the Adult Swim animated series Robot Chicken. He is also the co-creator and executive producer of SuperMansion and the voice of Robobot and Groaner.

Zeb Wells received huge criticism for his take on Spider-Man, with his Amazing Spider-Man book being regarded as one of the worst Spider-Man comic runs of all time.
